title: EventEnvelope
description: Canonical wrapper carried by every event on every Kafka topic in the PoC. Immutable once published.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier (UUID v4). Idempotency key.

causation_id.description: Immediate cause event_id. Null only for root events whose event_type is in ROOT_EVENT_TYPES.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier of the publishing agent or utility.

timestamp.description: Producer wall-clock (RFC 3339, tz-aware). Observability only; not used for ordering.

event_type.description: Identifies the payload schema and version. The vN suffix must match schema_version's major component.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the payload schema. Major must equal the vN in event_type.

payload.description: Type-specific body. Validated against the model registered for event_type.
